signs and symptoms of ARS include the following: headache, fever, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, myalgia, 
arthralgia, sore throat. If the patient has these symptoms for prolonged periods and mucocutaneous ulcers, 
then one should be especially suspicious of ARS and should consider taking PEP as the source will be at his/her 
most infectious state. The risk of acquiring HIV is 8-12 times higher if the source is in the window period.
